svg.aria-label: Hash table of six shingles under three hash functions, with the minimum over each set highlighted
svg.title: Hash table of six shingles under three hash functions, with the minimum over each set highlighted

text.tspan: MinHash: the minimum hash value over each set
Positions that agree: 1 of 3, so the estimate is 0.33; the true Jaccard is 0.5.
Blue = minimum over A, amber = minimum over B, green = both. Hash h(x) = (a·x + b) mod 11.
